subtitle: Two chapters carrying the In short section
description: A fixture for check-book.sh. Both chapters are structurally valid and both carry `## In short` directly under the header table. Chapter 1 has no carried-in line, having nothing behind it; chapter 2 carries in one term that chapter 1 glossed.

It exercises all five overview rules at once: the section is present, it is the first H2 with the header table immediately before it, it takes no paragraph tag and no provenance mark, its carried-in line is under the ceiling, and every carried term resolves to an earlier chapter in the glossary.
